frontmatter.title: Trillo - All-in-One Booking App
frontmatter.subheading: UI for fictional All-in-One Booking App
frontmatter.excerpt: Trillo is a fictional All-in-One Booking App that allows users to book hotels, flights, cars, and tours in one platform. The project is currently in the frontend mockup stage, built using modern technologies and best practices in web development. The mockup is a single-page application that is fully responsive, accessible, and optimized for search engines.
